programs.ignore_corner_seeds:
(rule!
      (let* ([h (rows g)] [w (cols g)]
             [seeds (for*/list ([sr (in-range h)] [sc (in-range w)]
                       #:when (and (not (= (list-ref (list-ref g sr) sc) 0)) (not (and (or (= sr 0) (= sr (- h 1))) (or (= sc 0) (= sc (- w 1)))))))
                      (list sr sc))])
        (for/list ([r (in-range h)])
          (for/list ([c (in-range w)])
            (let ([count (for/sum ([p (in-list seeds)])
                           (if (or (and (= r (first p)) (= c (second p)))
                                   (and (= (abs (- r (first p))) 1)
                                        (= (abs (- c (second p))) 1))) 1 0))])
              (if (> count 0) 8 0))))))
programs.xor_overlaps:
(rule!
      (let* ([h (rows g)] [w (cols g)]
             [seeds (for*/list ([sr (in-range h)] [sc (in-range w)]
                       #:when (and (not (= (list-ref (list-ref g sr) sc) 0)) #t))
                      (list sr sc))])
        (for/list ([r (in-range h)])
          (for/list ([c (in-range w)])
            (let ([count (for/sum ([p (in-list seeds)])
                           (if (or (and (= r (first p)) (= c (second p)))
                                   (and (= (abs (- r (first p))) 1)
                                        (= (abs (- c (second p))) 1))) 1 0))])
              (if (odd? count) 8 0))))))
